newsitem.title: CHINA: China mulls conversion to unleaded petrol by 2000.
newsitem.headline: China mulls conversion to unleaded petrol by 2000.

text.p: China is considering phasing out the use of leaded petrol by the year 2000 as part of a plan to improve the quality of its petroleum products, the Economic Information Daily said on Tuesday.

Under the proposal, state-owned China National Petroleum Corp (Sinopec) would first halt the use of leaded petrol in the major cities of Beijing, Shanghai, Tianjin, Guangzhou, Shenyang, Xi'an, Shenzhen and Zhuhai, the newspaper said.
Leaded petrol would be eliminated nationwide by 2000, it said but gave no detailed timetable.
